scope.task: Strict total-prefill LookM10% budget and original/official semantic audit

paper.summary: The paper counts selected history plus recent window as the compressed cache, and merges evicted keys into conserved keys with shared routing for V.

primary_sources.discovery: The paper itself links the official repository. No direct LookM official link was found in the searched local HybridKV README files; only method names in local code/docs.
primary_sources.lookup_limit: GitHub API tree lookup returned403 rate limit. Public official HTML resolved currentOid and commit-pinned raw sources were fetched read-only instead.

strict_budget_contract.requested_scope: Total cached prompt/prefill positions per native KV head, including the recent window, at cache construction.
strict_budget_contract.prompt_length: N = full valid prefill input length, including expanded visual tokens, text and special tokens; benchmark batch1 has no padding.
strict_budget_contract.total_capacity: C=floor(N*r), r=.1; enforce output_prefill_len<=C in every native KV head/layer.
strict_budget_contract.partition: For C>0 use W_eff=min(configured_recent_window,N,C); K_history=min(N-W_eff,max(0,C-W_eff)). For ordinary long video inputs W_eff32 and K_history=C-32.
must_not_do: Do not keep C historical positions and append32 recent positions.
Do not return full prompt when K_history0 if N>C.
Do not preserve an oversized window beyond C.
Do not silently replace C0 with capacity1 or full input.
strict_budget_contract.zero_capacity_policy: C0 requires either a correctly supported empty prompt cache or an explicit unsupported/ValueError before inference; never claim strict0-capacity while retaining prompt tokens.
strict_budget_contract.no_compression_case: When C>=N, return original full K/V without topk/empty-history reductions.
strict_budget_contract.decode_scope: This cap is for cached prompt history at prefill. Later generated-token K/V appends normally. After G generated tokens, the final cache typically includes C+(G-1) positions per head; a permanent total decode cap would require a separate explicit eviction policy and user decision.
strict_budget_contract.official_comparison: Official cache_size is hh_size+recent_size (:649,:662–664); the official example uses hh_ratio.1 and recent_ratio.1, hence nominal20% total, not a canonical total10% protocol. The present strict10% partition must be declared as the requested Qwen adaptation.

findings.issue: Dropped positions leak across heads and batches.
findings.actual: torch.isin operates on globally flattened positions. A token selected in any head or batch disappears from every other head/batch drop set; it can consequently vanish from both kept and merged positions in another head.
findings.official_evidence: Commit-pinned TextPivot computes a per-head expanded keep mask and its complement (:694–700), rather than global position membership.
findings.required_fix: Build a Boolean historical keep mask independently for each[b,h], scatter selected positions in that mask, and gather its exact complement for that same head. Exclude recent positions from the historical drop domain.
tests: Different head selections cannot change another head output.
Different batch samples cannot change another batch output.
Each head partitions its own historical positions exactly into selected and dropped; selected+drop count=N-W.

findings.issue: Original current select_num=floor(N*r) plus32 violates requested total10%.
findings.required_fix: Use the explicit total C partition, including zero-selection/window-clamp and no-compression guards. Preserve the observed long-video default window32 within C.

findings.official_note: Official TextPivot has the same128 assumption, consistent with its original backbone. This does not make it shape-general.
findings.required_fix: Use broadcasting/unsqueeze and the actual head_dim for gather/scatter index expansion. Preserve existing128-dimensional outputs apart from other explicitly corrected issues.

findings.issue: Zero-norm keys produce NaN cosine and can silently choose the wrong pivot even when final K/V remain finite.
findings.required_fix: Define finite cosine with FP32 normalization and positive epsilon, retaining signed cosine. Deterministically handle zero vectors; using zero cosine for a zero vector is a stated safe convention.
findings.limit: This defines behavior where mathematical cosine is undefined. It is a stability fix, not proof zero vectors occurred in earlier benchmark runs.

findings.issue: N<window, window0, history0/select0, and r1 can error or violate capacity.
findings.required_fix: Validate ratio/window domains; clamp the effective retained window; guard empty history before max/topk; explicitly construct recent-only or empty outputs instead of slicing with -0. For the public default32 path, rejecting a configured nonpositive window is acceptable if documented.

findings.issue: Recent retained positions participate in nearest-neighbor matching and can change K/V values.
findings.action: Keep selected history plus recent window as the conserved pivot set. Protected recent means retained positions, not immutable original K/V values. Excluding recent pivots would be a separate algorithm change.

findings.issue: Pivot pair averaging followed by scatter mean includes the original pivot.
findings.formula: For conserved p with m assigned evicted values e_j: p_out=(p+sum_j((e_j+p)/2))/(m+1)=((m+2)*p+sum_j e_j)/(2*(m+1)). Same routing and formula for V.
findings.equality: The inspected local scatter_reduce(mean,include_self=True) and official TextPivot pair-average/scatter lines705–711 implement this same formula; the paper Eq11 describes it.
findings.action: Preserve include_self and pair averaging; do not replace with a simple group mean or count-weighted mass merge.

findings.issue: Qwen native4KV heads are scored via repeatedK and aggregated query-head groups.
findings.action: Preserve native K/V storage and contiguous-group GQA mean. Do not merge/query-head-repeat the stored native cache or change mean to max as part of budget repair.
findings.basis: repeat_kv duplicates each native KV head consecutively, so reshaping query scores[B,Hkv,G,history] and reducing G maps scores back to the right native heads. The official LLaVA code is not a Qwen GQA reference.

findings.issue: Local text max-score boost followed by fixed topk is a bounded text-prior adaptation.
findings.action: Preserve text priority within K_history, with correct per-batch Boolean masks and padding exclusion. Do not append all text positions outside C or declare all text necessarily retained when text count exceeds K_history.
findings.official_limit: The official TextPivot uses fixed576-token image spans and a sign mask (:679–696), which can retain unselected positive text scores. Do not transplant this image-specific path to Qwen video or use it to waive the requested capacity invariant.

findings.issue: The first5% layer skip and last32-query score window are local HybridKV adaptations, not universal official LOOK-M settings.
findings.action: Preserve these choices during the requested budget/bug repair. Qwen7B28layers currently0/1 prune-only,2..27pivot; all layers must still obey totalC.
findings.official_lines: Official llava_llama.py:111–113 installs TextPivot on every layer. Official score accumulation modify_llama.py:719–724 sums attention scores; it does not define this local last32-query/first5% schedule.

CPU_reproducer.independent_expected_values: Cross-head and cross-batch expected[20,70] follow the exact preserved pivot formula applied to each head’s own complement. The epsilon-safe zero-norm convention yields[0,80].
CPU_reproducer.scope_limit: Small tensor structural/numerical edge tests; not GPU inference, model quality testing or a claim about prevalence in earlier long-video data.

implementation_review_acceptance: For every layer and native KV head, actual prefill length<=floor(.1*N), including recent positions; assert with real returned tensors.
Default long-input32-window leaves history capacity C-32; zero-history, short-prompt and full-capacity cases do not exceed C or crash accidentally.
Dropped positions are a per-batch/per-head exact complement, not a global union.
All dimensions are dynamic; zero-norm cosine is finite by an explicit convention; signed similarities remain signed.
Native GQA grouping, bounded text-score boost, local layer schedule and selected+recent pivot membership remain unchanged.
Pivot weights remain pair-average plus include_self mean for both K and V; prefill still computes its output attention with full originalK/V and stores only the compressed cache for later decode.
Fresh prompt cluster/cache and RoPE-state reset remain in effect; generated-token decode appends are reported separately from the prefillC cap.
Provenance must mark this as deliberate behavior change from the prior AST-identical migration. Earlier nominal10%+window results remain dated unchanged.

fix_validation.independence: AST-executed the actual two corrected functions plus existing repeat_kv on CPU; no project test helper or reference implementation from the implementation agent was called.
fix_validation.expected_value_basis: Independent scalar pivot weighting: [p+sum((e+p)/2)]/(m+1), each batch/head own historical complement; epsilon-normalized zero-key convention.

remaining_boundary_findings.issue: When select_num0, update_kv returns recent-only even in pivot-enabled layers, skipping merge of dropped historical tokens into recent pivots.
remaining_boundary_findings.reproducer: N320,r.1,window32,layer27; all K=e0; V positions0..319. TotalC32 gives empty history topk but288 evicted historical tokens.
remaining_boundary_findings.recommendation: If preserving pivot semantics at zero history selection, let pivot-enabled layers call the corrected merge_kv with empty indices and the nonempty recent pivot set. Keep prune-only layers recent-only. Otherwise explicitly document this additional short-budget algorithm change.

remaining_boundary_findings.issue: For ratio1,N64 all slots are preserved but topk reorders historical cache positions unnecessarily.
remaining_boundary_findings.reproducer: All K=e0,V=0..63,layer27,window32; output first V17 rather than0.
remaining_boundary_findings.recommendation: Return original K/V directly for capacity>=N to make the no-compression case a no-op. Cached RoPE attention can be permutation invariant mathematically, but this audit does not claim bitwise-equivalent decode after reordering.

remaining_boundary_findings.issue: Corrected source uses F.normalize in original tensor dtype, not the FP32 normalization recommended in this audit.
remaining_boundary_findings.observed_behavior: Zero-norm D2 CPU case is fixed with the finite epsilon convention. This validation did not establish overflow/underflow safety for every finite value/dtype.
remaining_boundary_findings.recommendation: Either use FP32 matching normalization or state the original-dtype compatibility tradeoff; do not claim an unexecuted FP32 normalization change.
